question: Among the tallest and shortest players in the database, find the one with the highest sprint speed recorded between 2013 and 2015, and return their name along with their finishing and curve scores.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p."XCL_123", pa."XCL_138", pa."XCL_145"
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
WHERE pa."XCL_131" BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  AND p."XCL_126" IN (SELECT MAX("XCL_126") FROM Player UNION SELECT MIN("XCL_126") FROM Player)
ORDER BY pa."XCL_151" DESC
LIMIT 1
